primary_estimator_reason: Selected because it combines propensity and outcome modeling, uses honest out-of-fold nuisance predictions, and remained stable relative to IPW and non-cross-fitted AIPW. It was not selected because it produced the largest estimate or the smallest synthetic-truth error.

heterogeneous_effects.individual_cate_reason: Multiple defensible CATE approaches failed to recover reliable individual-level treatment-benefit ranking on validation data.
heterogeneous_effects.subgroup_interpretation: Use as descriptive, predeclared heterogeneous-treatment-effect analysis; do not treat subgroup estimates as individual treatment guarantees.

rejected_methods.reason: Near-zero ranking correlation and excessive CATE dispersion.
Worse ranking recovery and greater dispersion.
Improved calibration but negative ranking correlation and negative top-bottom true-effect spread.

final_interpretation_policy: Report causal estimates only under the stated identification assumptions. Observed balance, overlap, stable weighting, cross-fitting, and sensitivity analysis support the adjustment design but do not prove absence of unmeasured confounding.
methodology_change_policy: Do not alter the primary estimand, primary estimator, feature policy, overlap policy, or heterogeneous-effect conclusions after this lock unless a reproducibility bug or technical defect is discovered.
